prose:
A Techmeme excerpt attributes to the Financial Times an OpenAI countersuit accusing Apple of trade-secret theft through a returning employee and pressure on shared suppliers. The framing describes claims in an escalating legal dispute, not a court finding.

The original article and court filing were unavailable in this pass, and no response from Apple was inspected. The excerpt cannot establish misconduct, liability, the identity or intent of any employee, or the completeness of either side's allegations. Trade-secret and supplier-pressure claims remain attributed allegations. No legal contact or account action was taken.
highlights: Coverage is limited to an attributed excerpt
Original filing and full article were not read
No employee intent or guilt is established
